dependencyState.rule: implement the release module now; do not edit or emulate S5B; an S5 import/failure after the release module loads is a typed external dependency, not permission to weaken S6

writeLease.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=false; sort_keys=true; separators=(',',':'); SHA-256

forbiddenWrites: all existing production modules including tools/news_grasp_cleanroom_install.py
live runtime, bin, Task Scheduler, network, external model or public state

publicApi.sideEffects: none; validators return detached plain dictionaries and never mutate caller values or filesystem

canonicalHash: SHA-256 over UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true and separators=(',',':')
closedWorldRules: reject bool where an integer is required, non-finite or negative counts, malformed ISO timestamps and non-lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 values
reject unknown, missing, duplicate or reordered closed-world rows; reject path traversal, absolute closure rows and separator aliases
when an optional outer authoritySha256 is present validate it over all other authority keys; its absence is valid for the original positive fixture
reject placeholder digests composed of one repeated hex character, including substituted preimage hashes
compare structures and hashes independently so a recursively resealed semantic negative still fails for its semantic cause

validation: source and installed launcher bytes must exist and match their declared hashes; source and installed digests must match
generationReceipt and its hash must bind generation and sourceSha256
taskXml bytes/hash, taskAction, executable, argv and workingDirectory must be internally consistent
each closure row has exact keys path,sha256,bytes and matches actual bytes under installedRoot; aggregate hash matches
each binding row has exact keys schemaVersion,relativePath,sha256, schema NEWS_GRASP_RUNTIME_BINDING_V1 and matches actual bytes; aggregate hash matches
each Task row has exact taskName/action/actionSha256, exact structured executable/arguments/workingDirectory semantics and aggregate hash
each owner receipt has exact ownerId,receiptSchemas,sourceSha256,installedSha256,taskActionSha256,preimageSha256,receiptSha256; values bind the enclosing authority and aggregate hash
loadedFreshness must be fresh and loadedGeneration must equal authority generation and expected context generation

layerEvidenceContract: sealed manifest and evidence are exact L0 through L7 in order with no duplicates
each evidence row exact-matches sealed realRequired, fakeSubstitution as fakeUsed and schemaIdentity, has non-empty realObserved, GREEN status and valid evidenceSha256
trusted receipt registry is exact S0 through S5; receiptId, schema, ACCEPTED status, issue date, generation, source commit, receipt bytes hash and receiptSha256 bind expected_context
installed authority is fully validated before GREEN is returned
return schemaVersion LAYER_EVIDENCE_V1, status GREEN and ordered layer names
finalAdmissionContract: admission is exact E2E_FINAL_ADMISSION_V1 and admissionSha256 is valid
issueDate/generation bind expected_context; acceptedReceipts exactly bind trusted S0 through S5 with no caller registry overwrite
layerEvidence and aggregate hash are valid exact L0 through L7 evidence
installedSourceSha256, installedHashSha256 and installedAuthoritySha256 bind fully validated installed authority
externalMutationSuppressed=true, externalMutationCount=0, attemptBudget=1, attemptsUsed=0, independentBlockerCount=0 and mode=final_confirmation_only
return a detached copy with status ADMITTED and no mutation
naturalEvidenceContract: natural evidence exact schema NATURAL_OPERATION_EVIDENCE_V1, valid naturalEvidenceSha256, issueDate/generation matching context
installed commit/hash/freshness bind expected context and fully validated installed authority
receipts are exact Scheduled,Audit,Public,Readiness; each exact NATURAL_OPERATION_RECEIPT_V1 with matching lineage/date/generation, terminalHash and receiptSha256
Scheduled, Audit and Readiness must be GREEN; Public may be GREEN or NOT_REQUIRED only with Scheduled GREEN

history is exact HISTORY_COVERAGE_V1: Asia/Tokyo, introduction 2026-07-23, 30 unique consecutive dates through issueDate, no missing days, counts Scheduled=63 and Audit=8, 30 sealed daily rows, 71 exact corpus rows, legacyWriterCount=0
daily and corpus provenance hashes must be recomputed from their semantic fields and referenced receipt hashes
negativeCoverage: all fixture historyCases, naturalCases and nonSubstitutionCases
all 20 installedClosureCases including recursively resealed semantic drift
caller inputs and temp filesystem inventory unchanged on every rejection

verification.expectedBeforeS5BIntegration: release module must import and validators must execute; failures caused solely by absent tools.news_grasp_cleanroom_install are an allowed typed dependency, never a Green claim
verification.regression: run S0 through S5 clean-room exact suites after S5B integration
verification.diff: git diff --check and exact one owned path only

implementationRules: use stdlib only and no environment reads except paths supplied in arguments
small pure validation helpers are preferred; no test imports, fixture hardcoding by case name or mutation-case branching
all failures raise ReleaseEvidenceError with non-secret typed diagnostics
do not modify a caller registry, normalize an invalid value into validity or silently ignore unknown keys

commitPolicy.allowedOnlyAfter: compile, Ruff, diff and the strongest dependency-aware S6 evidence available
commitPolicy.message: feat: implement S6 release evidence plane

causalRetry: one implementation attempt and one causally distinct correction only; never weaken tests or accept a same-shape retry
delivery: file hash/bytes, test evidence including typed S5 dependency if present, commit and clean status
stopPolicy: return to Sol after commit; no S5, install, live, global harness or test changes
